title: Structured Programming I
description: An introductory course in computer programming, algorithmic thinking, flowcharts, C programming, control structures, arrays, strings, functions, structures, and unions.
learningOutcomes: Explain the relationship between computer hardware, software, and programming languages.
Construct algorithms and flowcharts for simple problems.
Write, compile, test, and debug C programs.
Use variables, data types, operators, expressions, conditions, and loops.
Implement programs using arrays, strings, functions, structures, and unions.
